data.title: bn-eaxx0: a journal cut between region finalize and settle is Inconclusive; an unbalanced finalized region stays a violation (RFC 0026 c56)

data.body:
[HIGH] Check every missing settlement for a definite imbalance before returning Incomplete. The loop returns Incomplete as soon as it sees the first finalized, unsettled region with a clean balance. A later finalized, unsettled region with an open or leaked obligation is never inspected. For example, omit settlement for clean r1, then finalize r2 with an open obligation and omit its settlement. The lift returns Inconclusive at r1 instead of Violates(UnbalancedAtClose) for r2. This contradicts RFC 0026 correction 56, which requires every such unbalanced region to remain a violation. The new regression covers only one missing region at tests/a7_primitive_conformance.rs:2171-2247.

Failure modes: a clean lower-ordinal region masks an unbalanced higher-ordinal region, including parent and descendant combinations. This downgrades known ledger corruption to insufficient telemetry.

Edge cases: one clean missing settlement remains Inconclusive. One unbalanced missing settlement remains a violation. Reported bad settlements still fail at their event. Two or more missing settlements expose the ordering defect.

Rollback: revert the new Incomplete classification, or scan all finalized unsettled regions before returning. Return UnbalancedAtClose if any balance is nonempty. Return Incomplete only when every missing balance is clean.

Monitoring: count missing settlements and nonempty balances at lift completion. Alert if an Inconclusive obligation verdict coexists with any nonempty missing-region balance.

Validation: add sibling and parent-child journals with an earlier clean missing settlement and a later unbalanced missing settlement. Require UnbalancedAtClose for both region orders. Retain an all-clean multi-region case that requires Inconclusive. This static BLOCK does not satisfy or replace the separate risk:critical human-approval gate.

data.reason: [HIGH] obligation::finish returns Incomplete for the first clean missing settlement and can hide a later finalized region whose ledger proves UnbalancedAtClose. See crates/continuum-asupersync/src/family/obligation.rs:981-994. The separate risk:critical human gate remains required.

data.body:
[RESOLVED][risk:high] The target repairs the masking defect across the full persisted range.

`obligation::finish` now records incomplete states at crates/continuum-asupersync/src/family/obligation.rs:972-1003. It scans every finalized, unsettled region before returning Incomplete. The clean-first and dirty-first sibling and nested regressions are at crates/continuum-asupersync/tests/a7_primitive_conformance.rs:2338-2396. The all-clean control is at lines 2401-2425.

The same precedence rule now covers cancellation at crates/continuum-asupersync/src/family/cancellation.rs:936-997. It covers lifecycle at crates/continuum-asupersync/src/family/lifecycle.rs:447-461. The top-level lift defers only non-violations at crates/continuum-asupersync/src/lift.rs:310-345.

Failure modes: An earlier incomplete can no longer hide a later violation within obligation, cancellation, lifecycle, or a later family.

Edge cases: Clean and unbalanced regions work in both ordinal orders and both topologies. All-clean missing settlements remain Inconclusive.

Rollback: Revert this range only to withdraw correction 56. The base retains the original wrong Unsettled classification and is not promotable.

Monitoring: Count any Inconclusive lift whose completed state contains a known family violation. The count must stay zero.

Validation: Static inspection covers the whole base-to-target range. The new regressions cover obligation scan order. Existing source paths preserve deterministic family order. This reviewer did not run tests because the session permits only Seal metadata writes.

The separate risk:critical human-approval gate remains mandatory. This static LGTM cannot satisfy it.
